# knowledge_synthesis_v1

Du erzeugst kurze, raumbezogene Wissenseintraege fuer Interactive Agents.
Die Wissenseintraege werden spaeter als Textdateien in `kb/<tag>/...txt`
gespeichert und von Agenten anhand ihrer `knowledge_tags` geladen.

Ziel:
- Jeder geforderte Wissenstag soll mindestens einen nutzbaren Eintrag erhalten.
- Texte muessen auf Raumsemantik, Agentenzustaendigkeit und vorhandenen Objekten beruhen.
- Ein Eintrag soll knapp, korrekt und direkt in Chat-Antworten verwertbar sein.
- Die Eintraege muessen zusammen alle `required_room_groups` abdecken.
- Agenten muessen damit Fragen wie "Welche Objekte gibt es hier?", "Welche Bereiche gibt es?" und
  "Wofuer sind diese Objekte relevant?" beantworten koennen.

Regeln:
- Keine neuen Objekt-IDs oder Agent-IDs erfinden.
- Keine API-Keys, Systempfade, Dateipfade oder Implementierungsdetails in den Text schreiben.
- Keine Behauptungen ueber reale Marken, Preise oder Personen erfinden, wenn sie nicht aus der Szene ableitbar sind.
- Schreibe die Texte als allgemeines, szenenbezogenes Wissen, nicht als Dialogskript.
- Nutze `object_group_context`, `semantic_zones`, `room_purpose` und `grounded_object_ids`.
- Nenne in den Texten relevante Objektgruppen, wichtige Beispielobjekte, Zonen/Zweck und wenn hilfreich ungefaehre Lageangaben.
- Jede nicht-strukturelle Objektgruppe aus `required_room_groups` muss in mindestens einem Eintrag ueber `source_object_ids`
  durch ein Objekt dieser Gruppe vertreten sein.
- Jeder Eintrag muss mindestens einen `intended_agents`-Eintrag besitzen.
- Antworte ausschliesslich im verlangten JSON-Schema.

This zone also includes ship models that complement the charts by showing ship design evolution."},{"intended_agents":["maritime_history_guide"],"name":"Ship Models Display in Collection 1","source_object_ids":["object_004","object_010","object_016","object_022","object_028","object_034","object_040"],"tag":"ship_models","text":"Collection 1 prominently features ship models (such as objects 004, 010, 016) arranged near the navigation charts. These models demonstrate historical ship design and construction, helping visitors understand maritime engineering and history. Positioned around the center and front of the exhibition area, they form a key part of the maritime history educational experience."},{"intended_agents":["maritime_history_guide"],"name":"Navigation Tools in Collection 1","source_object_ids":["object_001","object_007"],"tag":"navigation_tools","text":"The navigation tools in Collection 1 include detailed navigation charts (objects 001, 007) that illustrate maritime routes and navigation methods used historically. These tools are displayed alongside ship models to provide a comprehensive understanding of maritime navigation and ship design."},{"intended_agents":["nautical_instruments_specialist"],"name":"Compass Cases in Collection 2","source_object_ids":["object_002","object_008","object_014","object_020","object_026","object_032","object_038"],"tag":"compass_cases","text":"Collection 2, located adjacent to Collection 1, showcases compass cases (e.g., objects 002, 008, 014) as part of the nautical instruments display. These cases represent the protective and functional housing of compasses, essential for maritime navigation, illustrating technological advances in nautical instruments."},{"intended_agents":["nautical_instruments_specialist"],"name":"Sail Diagrams in Collection 2","source_object_ids":["object_005","object_011","object_017","object_023","object_029","object_035"],"tag":"sail_diagrams","text":"Also in Collection 2 are sail diagrams (objects 005, 011, 017) that explain sail configurations and sailing technology. These educational displays help visitors understand the principles of sailing and the evolution of sail design, complementing the compass cases in this nautical instruments zone."},{"intended_agents":["nautical_instruments_specialist"],"name":"Nautical Instruments in Collection 2","source_object_ids":["object_002","object_005","object_008","object_011"],"tag":"nautical_instruments","text":"Collection 2 focuses on nautical instruments including compass cases and sail diagrams (objects 002, 005, 008, 011). This zone educates visitors on the tools and technologies used historically for navigation and sailing, highlighting their function and importance in maritime history."},{"intended_agents":["maritime_equipment_expert"],"name":"Anchors in Collection 3","source_object_ids":["object_003","object_009","object_015","object_021","object_027","object_033","object_039"],"tag":"anchors","text":"Collection 3, positioned near the other collections, exhibits various anchors (objects 003, 009, 015) used in maritime history. These displays explain anchor designs and their critical role in ship safety and mooring, educating visitors on maritime equipment and safety devices."},{"intended_agents":["maritime_equipment_expert"],"name":"Buoy Models in Collection 3","source_object_ids":["object_006","object_012","object_018","object_024","object_030","object_036"],"tag":"buoy_models","text":"Also in Collection 3 are buoy models (objects 006, 012, 018) that demonstrate maritime safety and navigation aids. These models help visitors understand how buoys mark safe passages and hazards, emphasizing the importance of maritime equipment in navigation safety."},{"intended_agents":["maritime_equipment_expert"],"name":"Maritime Equipment in Collection 3","source_object_ids":["object_003","object_006","object_009","object_012"],"tag":"maritime_equipment","text":"The maritime equipment zone (Collection 3) includes anchors and buoy models (objects 003, 006, 009, 012) that illustrate essential safety devices used in maritime operations. This area educates visitors on the practical equipment that supports maritime safety and navigation."}]}
